checks.expected: Every engineering model and important parameter has a source/status; proxies and unknowns are visible.
Reference dimensions and transforms agree; no hidden unit-scale errors.
Each part insertion, nut retention, fastening approach and finished-product extraction is explained and geometrically supported.
One frame follows the complete approved route and produces a coherent record.
Initial stock + receipts = final stock + consumption/scrap, with no negative quantities or duplicate part ownership.
Every required unique joint has the correct accepted attempt; duplicates/missing locations cannot satisfy the requirement.
Wrong/unlocked tool or absent clamp feedback inhibits the relevant action.
The cell holds/waits through a justified detector or incoming check; no magical substitution occurs.
Approved fault scenarios lead to hold/rework, preserving original and subsequent attempt records.
Stop behavior preserves product state; reset or access closure alone cannot restart automatic work.
Empty stock and shared service consume actual modeled waiting and operator time.
Product remains supported and unavailable capacity is reflected in results.
Identical configuration/seed yields identical process events/results; presentation frame rate does not alter them.
Good output, WIP, cycle times, downtime and utilization reconcile with the event history.
Selected candidates satisfy the configured sample criterion or report shortfall; resources and constraints are disclosed.
The rendered view and non-rendered engine agree on production results for the same scenario.
Invalid units, negative demand, inconsistent recipes, oversized runs and corrupted imports are rejected cleanly.
Deterministic time and simple resource bounds agree with hand checks; sensitivity is reported where inputs are uncertain.
A clean checkout/build identifies the deployed commit, model revision and available example scenarios.
Portfolio wording distinguishes a virtual station, verified logic/geometry and any genuinely completed physical validation.
